browserAllowCurrentAgentSession.zhCN: 允许当前 Agent 会话

browserAuthorizationAdvancedSummary.enUS: The Agent can also execute JavaScript, inspect captured network data, replay requests, and use CDP.
browserAuthorizationAdvancedSummary.zhCN: Agent 还可以执行 JavaScript、检查已抓取的网络数据、重放请求并使用 CDP。

browserAuthorizationDescription.enUS: Pi Desktop paused the Browser tool before it made any page, network, or input changes.
browserAuthorizationDescription.zhCN: Pi Desktop 已在页面、网络或输入发生任何更改前暂停浏览器工具。

browserAuthorizationInteractSummary.enUS: The Agent can also click, type, press keys, and scroll in Browser tabs owned by this session.
browserAuthorizationInteractSummary.zhCN: Agent 还可以在此会话拥有的浏览器标签页中点击、输入、按键和滚动。

browserAuthorizationReadSummary.enUS: The Agent can open pages, navigate, read page snapshots, and take screenshots.
browserAuthorizationReadSummary.zhCN: Agent 可以打开和导航页面、读取页面快照并截取屏幕。

browserAuthorizationSessionOnly.enUS: Allowing here lasts only for this running Agent session. Permanent permissions can only be saved in Browser settings.
browserAuthorizationSessionOnly.zhCN: 在此允许仅对当前运行中的 Agent 会话有效。永久权限只能在浏览器设置中保存。

browserAuthorizationTitle.zhCN: 允许 Agent 使用浏览器吗？
